10A.
Consideration and possible Council direction/action regarding the Encinitas v. Braun/Marr Settlement Subcommittee Report. Contact Persons: Mayor Gaspar and Deputy Mayor Kranz
1) Receive the Subcommittee report; 2) Approve the draft settlement and release agreement in substantial form; 3) Authorize the Subcommittee to work with staff to finalize the draft settlement and release agreement; and 4) Authorize the Mayor to execute the final draft of the settlement and release agreement on behalf of the Council.
2014-10-22 Item 10A - Braun-Marr Settlement Subcommittee Report
10B.
Report to City Council from the Pacific View Site Activation Plan Subcommittee. Contact Person: Council Members Barth and Shaffer
The Subcommittee is recommending that the Council direct staff to move forward with taxable bonds. This option gives the City the greatest flexibility. Additionally, interest rates between the two bond types are not significantly different. As to the use, based on public input and existing zoning, the Subcommittee proposes that the site be identified for use as an Arts, Education and Community Gathering Place with an emphasis on Theaters, Museums, Education, Outdoor Sales/Swap meets and park/recreation space, consistent with uses permitted in the P/SP zone either by right or with a Minor or Major Use permit. The Subcommittee also recommends that the Engineering and Public Works Department be directed to evaluate the usability of the existing buildings/structures on site, based on the above stated uses. Specifically, identify which structures are not viable and should be removed; and which can be made safe and usable. Next Steps:
If the council accepts the above recommendations, schedule additional Subcommittee meetings to address: * Escrow closing event/party at Pacific View (January 2015)
* Review Engineering and Public Works evaluation of existing buildings; basic site improvements.
* Develop interim use policies and invite proposals. Consider individual tenant agreements, city managed programs and/or master Major Use permit.
* Initial selection of interim uses.
* Develop visioning process for long term use.
2014-10-22 Item 10B - Pacific View Subcommitee Report
10C.
Consider Authorizing the Issuance of Lease Revenue Bonds by the Encinitas Public Financing Authority (the "2014 Bonds") to fund the acquisition of real property (Pacific View Property) and to fund Planned Capital Improvements at Moonlight Beach (Lifeguard Tower.) Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
1) Adopt City Council Resolution 2014-62, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas authorizing proceedings and agreements relating to the financing of the acquisition and construction of City improvements, approving issuance and sale of the 2014 Bonds by the Encinitas Public Financing Authority, approving an Official Statement and authorizing official actions; 2) Direct the City Manager, acting as the Executive Director of the Encinitas Public Financing Authority, to determine what portion of the overall bond issue should be issued as Tax-Exempt obligations and what portion, if any, should be issued as Taxable obligations.

Call to Order - Encinitas Public Financing Authority
.
1. Consider Authorizing the Issuance of Lease Revenue Bonds by the Encinitas Public Financing Authority (the "2014 Bonds") to fund the acquisition of real property (Pacific View Property) and to fund Planned Capital Improvements at Moonlight Beach (Lifeguard Tower.) Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
Recommended Action: 1) Adopt Encinitas Public Financing Authority Resolution 2014-01, a Resolution of the Board of Directors of the Encinitas Public Financing Authority (the "Authority") authorizing the issuance of its revenue bonds in the original principal amount of not-to-exceed $13,500,000 in connection with the acquisition of the Pacific View Property and improvements to the Moonlight Beach Lifeguard Tower, authorizing and directing execution of an Indenture of Trust, a lease Agreement, an Agency Agreement, a Purchase Agreement and authorizing an Official Statement and other official actions and execution of related documents; and 2) Direct the City Manager, acting as the Executive Director of the Encinitas Public Financing Authority, to determine what portion of the overall bond issue should be issued as Tax-Exempt obligations and what portion, if any, should be issued as Taxable obligations.
2014 -10-22 Item 01 - Encinitas Public Financing Authority Consideration of Lease Revenue Bonds for Pacific View and Moonlight Beach
ADJOURNMENT - Encinitas Public Financing Authority
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
